platform: SolidEdge Cloud Platform (SECP) — Engineering Truth OS

solvers.mathematicalBasis: Linear algebraic system G * V = I with conductance matrix G and current injections I
explicitExclusionsAndLimits: Does NOT model AC frequency response or reactive impedance (Capacitors, Inductors).
Does NOT model non-linear semiconductor switching dynamics (MOSFET/BJT switching losses, reverse recovery).
Does NOT model electromagnetic transients, transmission line reflections, or lightning surges (DO-160 Sec 22).
Power balance verification proves numerical convergence of the DC network, NOT real-world hardware adequacy.

solvers.solverName: PCB Copper Trace Conduction & Voltage Drop Evaluator
solvers.mathematicalBasis: R = rho * (L / (W * T)) * [1 + alpha * (T - 20)]; V_drop = I * R
governingLaws: ASTM B193 Electrical Resistivity of Metallic Materials

validityEnvelope.geometry: Rectangular cross-section with uniform width and thickness

explicitExclusionsAndLimits: Does NOT model skin effect, eddy currents, or high-frequency AC impedance.
Does NOT account for non-uniform etch factor (trapezoidal trace cross-sections) or surface roughness losses.
Does NOT account for microvia current crowding or localized voiding.

solvers.solverName: Lumped Parameter Theta-JA Junction Temperature Estimator
governingLaws: Fourier Conduction 1D Equivalent Lumped Resistance Network

validityEnvelope.thermalCoupling: Decoupled component nodes; steady-state DC dissipation
validityEnvelope.coolingRegime: Nominal still air convection or fixed heatsink Theta_JA rating

explicitExclusionsAndLimits: CANNOT be described or treated as 3D spatial CFD or Finite Element Thermal Analysis.
Does NOT model 3D conjugate heat transfer, spatial thermal plumes, or component-to-component thermal proximity heating.
Does NOT model transient thermal impedance curves (Z_theta(t)) under pulsed duty cycles.
Does NOT model radiation heat transfer in high-altitude rarefied atmospheres.

solvers.solverName: Wiring Harness Ampacity & Voltage Drop Checker
solvers.mathematicalBasis: Tabulated lookup from AWG resistance tables + empirical temperature derating

validityEnvelope.conductorGauges: AWG 10 to AWG 28 stranded copper wire

explicitExclusionsAndLimits: Does NOT model bundle internal temperature gradients where inner wires run significantly hotter than outer sheath.
Does NOT model altitude pressure derating for dielectric breakdown (Paschen's Law / corona discharge).
Does NOT compute mechanical bend stress or fatigue life in dynamic flex points.

solvers.mathematicalBasis: Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) and Oriented Bounding Box (OBB) spatial separation tests

validityEnvelope.geometryType: Rigid geometric boundary envelopes and cylindrical standoff coaxial alignment

explicitExclusionsAndLimits: Does NOT calculate structural stress, strain, or yield failure under mechanical shock/vibration.
Geometric standoff alignment does NOT prove structural endurance under sinusoidal or random vibration.
Does NOT model thermal expansion mismatch (CTE) causing solder joint shear fatigue.
